findings.first_contract: Cell permits all signed i16 endpoints and Direction offsets include +1 and -1; neighbour adds in i16 without explicit exhaustion handling. The generator emits coordinates 0..width-1 with width at most i16::MAX, giving its own generated footprint a one-neighbour margin. A separate public player-build edit stores walls without that margin.
findings.symbolic_source_trace: From an empty PlayerBuildDocument, a horizontal DrawWall with start=(0,32768), end=(1,32768), a valid wall style and storey 0 passes square-grid/nonempty checks, stores a North wall with cell=(0,32767), and returns Ok. If the resulting document is used by setup_player_build_scene, freeform_wall_faces computes its North neighbour before classifying floor; that adds 1 to i16::MAX. Checked-overflow arithmetic fails at the addition. Editor edit-adapter records accepted documents and requests a rebuild; whether this specific point is reachable through ordinary UI input and whether a specific application configuration invokes it are not established. This is source and symbolic reasoning only.

findings.first_contract: GridPoint owns fine lattice values, with 30 units per cell and metres conversion using CELL_SIZE_METRES/30. The wall edit accepts GridPoint endpoints but treats their i32 coordinates as whole-cell indices, and casts selected coordinates to i16 without representability checks. The editor producer itself divides snapped world metres by CELL_SIZE_METRES, confirming it supplies cell-scale counts under this nominal fine-grid owner.
findings.symbolic_source_trace: In an empty document, horizontal endpoints (0,0)→(1,0) and (65536,0)→(65537,0) are distinct i32 inputs yet the x as i16 conversion maps the respective one-cell walls to the same cell=(0,-1), North and same selector; separate documents avoid the duplicate-wall rejection. Inputs (32768,0)→(32769,0) similarly retain x=-32768. If start.z=i32::MIN, subtracting 1 occurs before conversion and can fail under overflow checks. The ownership mismatch exists in the source signature and UI projection; no normal UI reachability at such distant points or execution outcome is claimed.

nonfindings.claim: CellDiameter enforces a positive u16 via constructor and custom deserialization; grid-unit conversion rejects nonpositive, nondivisible and values beyond u16. Maximum u16 times 30 is 1,966,050, within i32. GridLength enforces strictly positive i32 and revalidates deserialization.

RoundTower keeps anchor and diameter private, checks both x and z parity in constructor with rem_euclid, and routes custom deserialization through the constructor. This seals the inspected parity relation, not wall dimensions, chord fit, whole plan identity or roof acceptance.
Direction covers four cardinal offsets and reversals. GridPoint and Cell permit signed positions; negative and zero coordinates must not be rejected merely because lengths are positive.

Test module source 199–331 was read as source only; it cannot establish executed validation. Roof graph and serialized room/storey member relationships belong their actual owners and cannot be closed from model.rs reexports.

lenses.assessment: Editor maps world metres to whole-cell counts then names them GridPoint; semantic wall and neighbour consumers carry the resulting Cell. Inspect other public producers before assuming this is the only convention.
Cell and GridPoint already represent distinct units; compare an explicit cell-corner owner and checked conversion before introducing another primitive wrapper.

Diameter and GridLength constructor and deserialization revalidate; Cell and GridPoint deliberately admit full signed values, so operations and player wall endpoint policies must cover or explicitly reject boundary inputs.

Direct i16 neighbour addition is the existing 774 endpoint candidate; i32 subtract then unchecked narrowing in the player edit is a connected separate first operation. Full CellDiameter multiplication remains within i32.

RoundTower anchor/diameter parity is jointly checked in construction and decoding. Wall cell/direction/room incidence and player document representability need their consuming boundary; type-correct fields alone do not certify a whole building.

Fine lattice point versus whole cell and diameter versus length have meaningful distinctions; using GridPoint for cell-scale DrawWall parameters creates a separate actual owner question, not an argument to merge all coordinate types.

30 fine units and 1.5 metres per cell derive the fine scale in one place. The competing semantic unit of wall endpoints is a type/producer issue, not independently established duplicated source truth.

Any future change should preserve valid negative and zero coordinates, Direction opposite mapping, ordinary footprint adjacency and intentional freeform wall behavior. Inspection of test source is not executed evidence.
Direction is a four-case cardinal enum with exhaustive offsets/opposites; no payload ownership defect established from this bounded source. Player edit variants remain larger independent scope.

Custom deserialization of private positive length/diameter guards invariants; replacing it with derived deserialization would admit zero or negative values. Other derives may follow plain-record semantics.

Fine grid and whole-cell edit corner meanings are different even when both use signed integers. Preserve useful diameter divisibility and parity instead of collapsing all positions and lengths into one scalar.
Custom decoder prose and Direction snake_case grammar serve native error/serialization boundaries; no string identity defect established in the assigned scope.

30 units/cell and 1.5 m/cell declare lattice scale, while +/-1 direction offsets have cardinal discrete meaning. Unchecked endpoint ranges and truncation need explicit policy, not mechanical wrapping of constants.
